vocabulary.definition: the activity of listening or watching music, radio, or videos directly from the internet as a continuous stream
vocabulary.example: I enjoy streaming my favorite songs on Spotify while I work.

vocabulary.definition: something popular and profitable, like a hit pop song or bestselling product
vocabulary.example: Their latest album was a commercial success, topping the charts for weeks.

vocabulary.definition: describing something that attracts attention and is easy to remember, often referring to a song or tune
vocabulary.example: The jingle in the commercial was so catchy that I couldn't stop humming it all day.

vocabulary.definition: a curated list of songs that can be played in a specific order, either by a radio station or an individual
vocabulary.example: I created a playlist of my favorite relaxing songs to listen to before bedtime.

vocabulary.definition: having a strong influence or impact on something
vocabulary.example: The new marketing campaign is driving sales up for the company.

vocabulary.definition: to record, count, or measure something officially
vocabulary.example: Every vote in the election will be registered to ensure accuracy.
